title: Ninenin tarifi

characters.NINE: a grandmother with white hair in a loose bun and round glasses, wearing a lilac dress and a floral apron
characters.GIRL: her granddaughter, a little girl of about seven with curly chestnut hair, wearing a yellow dress
characters.WOMAN: a young woman of about thirty with curly chestnut hair, wearing a mustard yellow sweater

scenes.text:
Ninenin tarifinde ölçü yoktu,
hep "Göz kararı" derdi.
scenes.prompt: In a sunny old kitchen in autumn, {NINE} pours flour from her hand into a big bowl without measuring, smiling, while {GIRL} watches from a stool.
{GIRL} sits on a wooden stool with her chin on her hands, watching {NINE} knead soft dough on a floured table, warm afternoon light.

scenes.text: Yıllar sonra aynı tadı tutturmaya çalıştın.
scenes.prompt: In a small modern kitchen on an autumn evening, {WOMAN} kneads dough alone with flour on her cheek, concentrating, a warm lamp above.

scenes.text:
Olmadı.
Çünkü tarifte yazmayan bir şey vardı.
scenes.prompt: {WOMAN} tastes a piece of fresh bread at her kitchen table and smiles softly with a little sadness, autumn leaves outside the window.

scenes.text:
Eksik olan un değildi,
seni seyreden o sıcak gözlerdi.
scenes.prompt: {WOMAN} kneads dough at her kitchen table while a little girl in a yellow dress watches her from a stool, both smiling, warm golden light.

caption:
Bazı tatlar tarifle değil, sevgiyle yapılır. Ninenin hangi yemeğini özlüyorsun? 🤍

Bunu aynı mutfakta büyüdüğün birine gönder.
